def record(label,argv):
 start=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat();t=time.monotonic()

',out,re.M),failures=re.findall(r'^(?:FAIL|ERROR): .*$',out,re.M))
 (ROOT/(label+'.json')).write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(r),flush=True)
